title: Restore pacman database from backup
summary: Restore the local pacman database from a previously created backup archive. Use this if your package database is corrupted.
prerequisites: You have a backup file named pacman_database.tar.bz2 in the root directory (/).

steps.explain: Extract the backup archive to restore the pacman database.

rollback.explain: If the restore fails, you may need to reinstall pacman or use a live USB to fix the system.

warnings: Ensure the backup file is in the root directory (/) before running this command. Incorrect restoration can break package management.
